messages:
Leah: two tiny life updates: were expecting a baby in November and I got promoted to Staff Designer today!! :sparkles::baby::tada: low-key overwhelmed but thrilled. thinking a tiny lunchtime celebration next Thurs?
Ben: WHOA congrats x2!! :confetti_ball: thats huge. Thurs lunch works for me.
Zara: omg leah!!! so happy for you both :heart_eyes: i can bring a savory tart and a non-alcoholic spritz.
Carlos: Congrats!! :raised_hands: Staff Designer!! also baby!! Cant wait to celebrate. Thurs works, ill grab something from the bakery.
Maya: Double congrats!! I vote: cake or bagels? also i have a tiny handmade baby blanket i love to pass along if thats okay.
Leah: thank you!! love the blanket idea maya <3 re: food poll: :cake: cake, :bagel: bagels, :pizza: pizza. low-key please.
Ben: :bagel: (defensive pick)
Zara: :cake:
Carlos: :pizza: (im always pizza)
party-bot: Reminder set: "Leah double-win" at 3087729600 (Thu 12:30)  4 RSVPs so far. React by EOD Wed to RSVP.
Leah: thanks team. no gifts please, just vibes and carbs. i love if someone could help set up the lunch table at 12:15. i also like a tiny card we can sign for the baby. dm me if youd like the registry link. :heart:
